rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: The Secretariat's communiqué dated 26 September 1997 reports that the first plenum met that day and, under the amended rule 31, elected the Executive Committee chair, the head of the Secretariat and the vice-chairs ('改定された党規約第三十一条にもとづき幹部会委員長、書記局長、幹部会副委員長を選出'); it names no Central Committee chair among the offices filled and names no person elected.

rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: It reports that at the plenum 不破委員長 spoke on the immediate tasks ('総会では、当面の活動について不破委員長が発言した').
